reason: 'Flowers unopened', 'capitulum remaining unopened' state that the flower or head stays closed. Cleistogamous (FLOPO:0991176) would claim more than the text says.
'Transverse section V-form' means V-shaped in section. The section belongs in the record as the view.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (region of the bearer: apex of the keel, colour violet)
reason: A colour confined to the tip of the part, which is a region plus a colour, not a single quality. Unlike spine-tipped, there is no shape to name.

target: not bearded (FLOPO:0991118), region: inner surface of the corolla tube
reason: A hairy annulus is a ring of hairs inside the corolla tube, which is the 'zone' of bearded. Annulus itself was rejected as a generic part, and the absence of hairs in general would say too much.
'Without subulate apiculum or seta' says the tooth or blade does not end in an abrupt fine point. Apiculum was rejected as a bearer, and negating sharpness would wrongly exclude acute teeth.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values: acute (sensu botany) FLOPO:0991095 – obtuse PATO_0001935)
reason: An apex or base between acute and rounded, a compound of two shape values. The previous review grounded 'rounded' as obtuse (roundish).
'Adhered to the cupule', 'adheridas a segmentos' = sticking to another structure. When the other part is named, it fills the relation of pattern 09.

label: agamospermous
definition: A reproductive quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its producing seeds asexually, without fertilization.
reason: A real reproductive mode (Taraxacum, Boechera) with no PATO or FLOPO term. The second-model review of 2026-11-14 proposed it, but it has not been added, and 'apomictic' also has about 40 candidate statements in WFO.

A style or connective widened at its base. PATO inflated (PATO_0002376) means filled with air, so dilated is the right reading, as for 'expanded'. 'Basally' is a region context word and 'slightly' a degree.

target: new: arrangement of the indumentum (pubescent hair PATO_0001320, hairs in two lines: distichous PATO_0001952 on trichome PO_0000282)
reason: Pubescence confined to two opposite lines down the stem or petiole: one quality of the part plus the arrangement of its hairs. Bearded needs long hairs and does not fit.
A base that is broadly wedge-shaped. 'Broad' is a degree, and earlier reviews treat it as no quality of its own.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values: cuneate PATO_0001955 – obovate PATO_0001936)
reason: A compound of two shape values, the same case as 'obovate-cuneate' in the 2026-11-14 review. Cuneiform was already ruled to cuneate.
Descendent = directed obliquely downward, the existing FLOPO value class.
Ebeneous = ebony-black. It describes the glossy black stipes of ferns, and the glossiness is stated separately.
Ellipsoid is an EXACT synonym of elliptic. 'Elongate' is a degree of the same shape and stays in the record. Prolate (PATO_0001866) would be the only alternative.

target: docs/odp/10-ratio-to-another-part.md (as long as) or docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (longer than), joined by docs/odp/07-alternatives.md
reason: A comparison with a named second part (the petals), given as two alternatives.
Puncticulate = minutely punctate. The rust colour belongs to the dots, which have no part class, so only the dotting is grounded and the colour stays in the record text.
Gladiate = sword-shaped. PATO_0002235 has ensiform and sword-shaped as synonyms.
Glochid is a synonym of trichome in PO. The statement is a length (PATO_0000122) of glochids on the nutlets, which is a part of the fruit (pattern 12).
Nodding is grounded as drooping in the reviewed pairs, and 'half-' is an approximation of that value, like 'sub-'.
Hebetate = having a blunt or soft point, which is the existing PATO value.

label: monad (pollen)
definition: A spatial pattern quality inhering in pollen by virtue of its grains being shed singly, not united into tetrads, polyads or pollinia.
reason: A standard palynological character (monad, tetrad, polyad) with no term. FLOPO solitary is defined by an attachment site, which pollen grains do not have. WFO has about 38 candidate statements.
Verrucose is ruled to warty. 'Inconspicuously' is a degree and does not mean minutely warty (verruculose).
Inversely pear-shaped = obpyriform, the existing FLOPO value class.
Both leaf surfaces of the same colour = concolorous, the opposite of discolorous (FLOPO:0991070).
'Laxly several-flowered' is an indefinite count of flowers plus the lax arrangement of the inflorescence, which is already ruled to loose.
Apiculate is an EXACT synonym of PATO_0000944, and the reviewed combinations use it for apiculate apices. 'Long' is a degree that stays in the record.

target: new: extreme member of a series (length PATO_0000122 of the longest inflorescence axis internode PO_0006326)
reason: A measurement of the longest of a series of parts. The internode is chosen by its size rather than its place, so pattern 18 (position) and pattern 05 (extremes of a range) do not fit.
A midrib, vein or stem that winds back and forth is sinuous, like flexuous in the previous review.
Ellipsoid is an EXACT synonym of elliptic. 'Narrow' is a degree, treated like 'narrowly' in the earlier reviews.
